principles: Fix at the source, not the symptom: correct the lock-acquire budget rather than widen the retry band-aid.
Don't repeat yourself: converge the three duplicated lock loops onto the one audited shared primitive.
Preserve correct behavior: keep lock paths, per-story commit serialization, and external semantics unchanged.
Prove before removing a safety net: retire a retryOnAnyFailure flag only with empirical evidence.
drivers: Concurrent multi-reviewer REVIEW on a loaded machine must not spuriously fail acquiring a per-story metadata lock.
The deadline>staleMs invariant must hold so a crashed holder's lock is reclaimable (5s<10s violates it).
Changes limited to the 6 allowed paths; shared helper and frozen subsystems untouched.

options.name: do-nothing-keep-stopgap
cons: Permanent band-aid the user asked to remove

rationale: Migrating to withMkdirLock fixes the root cause (5s->30s) AND removes duplicated invariant-violating code, converging on the audited primitive checklist.ts already uses; a literal bump fixes the symptom but keeps three fragile copies.

preMortem.trigger: A previously-flagged smoke has a SECOND load sub-cause beyond the 5s lock budget.
preMortem.consequence: Removing its retryOnAnyFailure flag re-introduces non-deterministic red test:all runs.
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-002 gates removal on heavy --no-retry stress (>=24 runs, 0 FAIL) per smoke; keep the flag + file a finding for any that still fails.

preMortem.scenario: Hidden assertion on the old timeout message
preMortem.trigger: Some test depends on the literal 'timed out waiting for metadata lock' string.
preMortem.consequence: Switching to withMkdirLock's message format silently breaks that test.
preMortem.mitigation: grep confirmed no asserter outside the 3 handlers; REVIEW reviewers re-verify.

preMortem.trigger: withMkdirLock defaults (e.g. failFastIfHeld) differ from the hand-rolled wait-and-poll behavior.
preMortem.consequence: Lock contention starts fail-fasting instead of waiting, changing command semantics.
preMortem.mitigation: Call withMkdirLock with only a label so defaults stay poll-and-wait/30s/10s; reviewers confirm no failFastIfHeld is passed.
